mentions.name: NanoGame
mentions.description: A WebAssembly game framework for building small games that work great on mobile, native PC, and web. The host is written in Rust and the games are written in AssemblyScript; a number of the author's other small games have been ported to it.
mentions.problem: The author was frustrated with ebitengine's web builds and wanted small games that work great on mobile or native PC as well as on web.
mentions.source_excerpt: I started them with ebitengine (Golang) but got somewhat frustrated with its web builds, and so built my own thing for small games that I want to work great on mobile or native PC, but also on web.  I call it NanoGame, the host is written in Rust and the games are AssemblyScript.
